status: Engineering testnet definition. Not a mainnet launch, not an audit, not an authorization for any irreversible financial action.
normative_sources: specs/ECONOMICS.md v0.4 (reward allocation and monetary base)
network/swarm-testnet/RECIPE.md (how the genesis block was produced)

identity.ticker_note: Coin ticker settled by the owner's style guide, 2026-09-21. The chain and network names stay SWARM / SwarmTestnet. A label only: nothing about the genesis or consensus depends on it.

consensus.implementation: Zebra 6.3.0, configured Testnet, unmodified consensus and cryptography
consensus.target_difficulty_limit_note: The upstream Testnet bound. An easier limit can overflow the 17-target difficulty average.

genesis.premine: none; upstream excludes genesis outputs from the UTXO set

generator.reproduction_note: Four runs of the checksum-verified CI binary into four fresh folders, all producing byte-identical genesis.hex (sha256 1d2ffff8cbcb872167cc5d7d30f82d62aa997e45a0d82dafe9f1da053a6e0d6f) and identical generator manifests. The installed file was then verified independently in pure Python, with no Rust involved: the 1487-byte header decodes to version 4, an all-zero previous-block hash, the upstream merkle root, time 1789992000, bits 2007ffff, nonce ...0001 and a 1344-byte Equihash solution, and its double-SHA256 in display order is the recorded genesis hash.

independent_verification.method: pure-Python decode of the installed genesis.hex and recomputation of SHA256d(header)

generator.accepted_by_a_node: Submitted through zebrad 6.3.0's own submitblock; the node reported it as the block at height 0 and then mined and accepted block 1 and block 2 immediately. Evidence: docs/swarm-genesis-block1-proof-2026-09-21.json

genesis.time_rule: The header time must be in the PAST when the network starts. A block's time must exceed the median time past of its ancestors, and for block 1 that median is the genesis time, so a future genesis time blocks block 1 until the wall clock passes it.

supersedes.reason: its header time was in the future, which would have blocked block 1 until 2026-09-22 00:00:00 UTC

genesis.hex_note: The genesis block bytes. A fresh node normally receives block 0 from a peer; Zebra only inserts genesis by itself on Regtest. When no peer has served it, SWARM Node hands these bytes to its own node once and checks the resulting hash.

economics.miner_note: The miner receives the remainder of the subsidy after the three allocations, plus all transaction fees.

funding_stream_height_range.note: One range covers the whole emission schedule: every block with a non-zero reward.

economics.immutability: The percentages are part of the network definition every node loads. There is no admin key, vote, on-chain parameter or RPC that can change them. A destination can only change through a protocol upgrade that participants adopt together.
economics.rpc_naming_note: getblocksubsidy prints the upstream slot names. ECC is Core Development, MajorGrants is Grants & Ecosystem, ZcashFoundation is the Community & Development Reserve.

ports.public_p2p_note: Zebra's default Testnet P2P port. Other ports only produce warnings, but the default keeps newcomers' configuration empty.
ports.rpc_note: Loopback only. The node RPC is never exposed publicly; cookie authentication stays enabled.
ports.lightwallet_grpc_note: Zaino, behind TLS on the public server.

seed_peers_note: Placeholder. There is no DNS seeder for custom networks, so this is a static name with one A record per seed node. Zebra makes one outbound connection per IP, so a second seed needs its own public IP.

destination_addresses.shape: one secp256k1 key per destination (1-of-1 multisig redeem script), owner decision of 2026-09-21; multisig is deferred to a future mainnet
destination_addresses.key_files: D:/privacy/.runtime/swarm-testnet/destinations/<label>.keys.json (git-ignored, ACL restricted to the owner and SYSTEM)
destination_addresses.requirement: Every recipient must be a testnet P2SH address. zebra-consensus/src/block/check.rs asserts 'address must be P2SH' and the node panics on a tm.../t1.../t3... address.
destination_addresses.custody: Whoever holds a key file controls that destination's coins. If a key file is lost the coins paid to that destination can never be spent. Spending from P2SH is not supported by the desktop wallet or Zallet today, so until a spending path is demonstrated these balances are reported as received and visible, not as spendable.

baseline_miner.purpose: payout of the project's always-on one-thread miner on the seed server; NOT part of the consensus rules and NOT one of the three allocation destinations; the owner may rotate it to a personal wallet address after launch
baseline_miner.set_in_config: [mining].miner_address on the seed node only; render with render_config.py --miner-address --internal-miner

sync_gate.note: Tip age is a weak hint only. Block spacing averages 60-90 s but is a Poisson process, so multi-minute gaps are ordinary and a rule that needs a young tip holds back a synced node.

channels_note: Set by the owner on 2026-09-21. No other account or address speaks for the project. The project never asks for recovery phrases, private keys or payments through any channel.
